units.source_text: 她满怀悲伤，口虽不言，形容自见。

en.t: She was filled with sorrow; though she said nothing, it was plain in her appearance.
Prince Niou felt boundless pity and tenderness for her.

units.source_text: 二女公子怀着少女的柔情，目送朝阳中雄姿英发的情郎，偷偷地贪赏他遗下的衣香，好一片风流心情啊！

en.t: The second young lady, filled with a maiden's tender feelings, watched her gallant lover depart in the morning sun, then secretly savored the fragrance left on his robes; what a deeply romantic mood it was.

units.source_text: 他今晨迟归，阳光照得分明，故众侍女都能窥见他的姿态。

en.t: Because he returned late that morning and the sunlight shone clearly, all the waiting women were able to glimpse his figure.

units.source_text: 她们都啧啧赞美，说道：“中纳言也很俊俏可爱，然而带有一种严肃之相。

en.t: They all praised him admiringly, saying, "The Middle Counselor too is handsome and charming, but he has a certain grave look about him.

units.source_text: 这位亲王呢，恐是身份更高之故吧，丰姿特别优美。”

en.t: As for this prince, perhaps because his rank is even higher, his bearing is especially graceful."
